Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. # - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.

payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the same DVD that appears as the dark disc-shaped object at the right of SOURCE visibly white in EDITED?
node.criteria: Compare the dark disc-shaped object at the right of SOURCE with the objects in EDITED. Pass only if an object can be reliably matched to that source disc by its disc shape and corresponding right-side scene position, and its visible surface is predominantly white. Fail if the reliably matched disc remains non-white or black. Unknown if no object can be reliably matched to the source disc or its color cannot be judged. Do not count the separate white disc at left in EDITED without establishing that it corresponds to the source disc.
node.binding: The target is the dark disc-shaped object at the right of SOURCE, matched in EDITED by disc shape and corresponding scene position; the separate white disc at left is not the target absent reliable correspondence.
node.source_quote: transform the black DVD into a white DVD
node.endpoint: The same DVD from SOURCE is visibly white in EDITED.
node.necessity: The instruction requests changing the black DVD to white. SOURCE visibly contains a dark disc-shaped object at right, and EDITED shows a white disc at the corresponding right-side location; matching this plausible source-to-edited correspondence is necessary to assess the requested color change without treating an unrelated white disc as evidence.

node_traces.evidence: SOURCE has a dark disc-shaped object on the right. EDITED shows a white disc with a center hole at the corresponding right-side position, matching the source disc by shape and location; its visible surface is predominantly white. The separate white disc farther left is not needed for this match.
